title: Puzzle Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 🧩️puzzle plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧩️puzzle/, crate semio-s-plugin-puzzle) to the newly-amended Shape V2 tree-purity rule per TEMPLATE.md §14. Pure mechanical relocation, no logic changes: (1) move 📦️lib.rs from the owner root into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, update [lib] path and prefix every #[path] string with ../../; (2) fold any sibling variant files (🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs, etc, per app — 3 apps: 2d/3d/5d) into their own <folder>/🦀️component.rs; (3) relocate any nested 📚️examples/🧫️fixtures/🤖️generated/🛂️manifest.json to the owner root, sibling of 📦️packages (excluding 🔨️modules/ which is out of scope); (4) relocate any nested AGENTS.md/README.md to owner root unless a collision is found (owner root already has both, confirmed by earlier recon) in which case STOP and flag. Verify with cargo check/clippy -D warnings/test -p semio-s-plugin-puzzle --lib (baseline ~377 tests, must match exactly), plus wasm32-wasip2 check. Confirm the two external dependent crates with real deps on puzzle (semio-framework-os-kernel-surface-board-2d, semio-framework-os-renderer-wgpu) still check clean. Scope strictly limited to ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧩️puzzle/ excluding 🔨️modules/; never touch root Cargo.toml, other plugins, or framework files.
summary:
Retrofitted the already-migrated 🧩️puzzle plugin (3 apps: ◻2d/🧊️3d/🖐️5d) to Shape V2 tree purity per TEMPLATE.md §14. Pure mechanical relocation, zero logic changes, zero test-count drift.

1. Entry file: moved 📦️lib.rs → 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs. Updated [lib] path from "../../📦️lib.rs" to "📦️lib.rs". Prefixed all 132 non-dot #[path] leaf attributes (of 174 total #[path] attrs, 42 are grouping "." paths) with "../../". Updated the header doc-comment to the Shape V2 wording convention already used by other retrofitted plugins (cad, vcs, block, procedural, space).

2. Folded 19 sibling variant files into their own component folders (fitting emoji chosen per file's own doc-comment topic, matching repo-wide convention for config/terminology/wasm):
   - Apps (🎚️config, 🗣️terminology, 🌉️wasm — one set per app, ◻2d has no wasm.rs):
     🎛️apps/◻2d/🦀️config.rs → 🎛️apps/◻2d/🎚️config/🦀️component.rs
     🎛️apps/◻2d/🦀️terminology.rs → 🎛️apps/◻2d/🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs
     🎛️apps/🧊️3d/🦀️config.rs → 🎛️apps/🧊️3d/🎚️config/🦀️component.rs
     🎛️apps/🧊️3d/🦀️terminology.rs → 🎛️apps/🧊️3d/🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs
     🎛️apps/🧊️3d/🦀️wasm.rs → 🎛️apps/🧊️3d/🌉️wasm/🦀️component.rs
     🎛️apps/🖐️5d/🦀️config.rs → 🎛️apps/🖐️5d/🎚️config/🦀️component.rs
     🎛️apps/🖐️5d/🦀️terminology.rs → 🎛️apps/🖐️5d/🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs
     🎛️apps/🖐️5d/🦀️wasm.rs → 🎛️apps/🖐️5d/🌉️wasm/🦀️component.rs
   - Artifact engines:
     🗿️artifacts/◻2d/⚙️engine/🦀️icons.rs → …/🔣️icons/🦀️component.rs
     🗿️artifacts/◻2d/⚙️engine/🦀️linking.rs → …/🔗️linking/🦀️component.rs
     🗿️artifacts/◻2d/⚙️engine/🦀️board_host.rs → …/🎲️board-host/🦀️component.rs
     🗿️artifacts/◻2d/⚙️engine/🦀️layout.rs → …/📐️layout/🦀️component.rs
     🗿️artifacts/◻2d/⚙️engine/🦀️brush.rs → …/🖌️brush/🦀️component.rs
     🗿️artifacts/🧊️3d/⚙️engine/🦀️fill.rs → …/🪣️fill/🦀️component.rs
     🗿️artifacts/🧊️3d/⚙️engine/🦀️session.rs → …/⏳️session/🦀️component.rs
     🗿️artifacts/🧊️3d/⚙️engine/🦀️brush.rs → …/🖌️brush/🦀️component.rs
     🗿️artifacts/🧊️3d/⚙️engine/🦀️geometry.rs → …/📐️geometry/🦀️component.rs
     🗿️artifacts/🖐️5d/⚙️engine/🦀️transfer.rs → …/✂️transfer/🦀️component.rs
     🗿️artifacts/🖐️5d/⚙️engine/🦀️compose.rs → …/🌉️compose/🦀️component.rs
   Only the #[path] value and physical location moved; every `mod`/`pub mod` identifier is unchanged, so no `use crate::…` site anywhere needed updating (verified by search — zero hits).

3. Data relocated to the owner root (sibling of 📦️packages):
   - 📚️examples/: merged all 3 apps' 📚️examples/ (2 files each) into one flat ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧩️puzzle/📚️examples/, disambiguated by the pre-existing distinct extensions (.puzzle2d/.puzzle3d/.puzzle5d — no collisions).
   - 🧫️fixtures/: the 3 apps' 🛂️manifest/*.json files were reclassified as test fixtures (their one live include_str! consumer, board_host's test module, only ever used them inside #[cfg(test)]) and relocated to ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧩️puzzle/🧫️fixtures/<app>/ (app-subfoldered since all 3 apps' files share the identical name "🛂️manifest.jsondefault.manifest.json" — flat merge would have collided). This is a judgment call beyond TEMPLATE.md's literal single-file "🛂️manifest.json" wording, made because puzzle is the first multi-app plugin retrofit to hit colliding per-app data filenames; flagging explicitly for registrar/orchestrator awareness. Found 3 of the 4 manifest json files (◻2d's concrete-forest one, 3d's and 5d's default ones) have zero Rust references anywhere in the crate — orphaned pre-existing data, left in place untouched (relocation only, no pruning, per scope).
   - Fixed every include_str! reference (6 in the three 🗣️dsl/component.rs files for examples, 2 in ◻2d's folded 🖌️brush/component.rs for examples, 1 in ◻2d's folded 🎲️board-host/component.rs for the fixture manifest) to the new paths/depths.

4. AGENTS.md/README.md: no collision. Only the owner-root AGENTS.md/README.md exist in the taxonomy tree; the sole other hit (🔨️modules/🖼️assets/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/AGENTS.md) is under the explicitly out-of-scope 🔨️modules/ tree, untouched, FYI only.

VERIFICATION — all real, synchronous, against the actual root workspace (norm's earlier dangling-manifest blocker and a transient trinity/block dangling-manifest and cross-session overlay collision both self-resolved mid-session; also independently proved via a temporary TEMPLATE.md §3 workspace overlay before that, cleanly removed + nested target/Cargo.lock deleted afterward):
- cargo test -p semio-s-plugin-puzzle --lib: 377 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored — exact match to the known pre-retrofit baseline, zero drift.
- cargo check -p semio-s-plugin-puzzle: exit 0, zero warnings from puzzle itself.
- cargo check -p semio-s-plugin-puzzle --target wasm32-wasip2: exit 0, clean.
- cargo clippy -p semio-s-plugin-puzzle --all-targets -- -D warnings: puzzle's own code proven 0 warnings via the isolated-overlay run; the real-workspace invocation is blocked before puzzle even gets linted by a pre-existing clippy::needless_range_loop violation in semio-framework-os-kernel-dsl-core (never touched, out of scope) — not introduced by this retrofit.
- Manual #[path]-declaration ↔ on-disk-file bijection check: 132 declared leaf paths ↔ 132 .rs files under 🗿️artifacts+🎛️apps, perfect 1:1 match, zero orphans, zero dangling paths.
- External dependents: semio-framework-os-kernel-surface-board-2d checks clean (only 4 pre-existing unused-import warnings on puzzle:: symbols — imports RESOLVE correctly, confirming the module-path contract is intact); semio-framework-os-renderer-wgpu shows exactly its 3 known pre-existing errors (HostEffect/dsl_core/request_media_frames, flagged since W0-A per master.md), zero new errors.
- Tree purity re-check: zero stray *.rs/*.ts files outside 🦀️component.rs/📦️packages below the owner root (excluding 🔨️modules/, out of scope).

Registrar handoff: none needed — `[lib] path` is internal to the crate, root Cargo.toml's member line is unchanged, and `grep -rn "🔌️plugins/🧩️puzzle/📦️lib.rs" .` found zero external references. FYI only: .storybook/stories/puzzle/3d/World.stories.tsx references a stale pre-V1-migration path (⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📚️examples/…) that was already broken/frozen before this retrofit (per the V1 ticket's own summary) — untouched, out of scope, not made any more or less broken by this work. 🔨️modules/ (puzzle's TS-only module, including its own nested AGENTS.md) was left entirely untouched per scope.
